songs.title: Frizzed and Fractured V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, deathcore breakdowns, aggrotech, 155 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic chorus, distorted supersaw synth, explosive electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(heavy electronic chugs, blast beat)
(male deep guttural roar)
WITCH IN THE TREES!
(female brutal scream)
SPARK AND BURN!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Battle in the graveyard! Witches in the sky!
Green spell flying! Hit me in the eye!
Zap through the shoulder! Static in the air!
What the hell happened to my fur and hair?!
Sizzling! Smoking! Standing end to end!
How am I supposed to fight and defend?!
It’s purple! It’s frizzy! It’s glowing in the dark!
Every single follicle shooting off a spark!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Spells crack! (Male: HIT!)
Sparks fly! (Male: FRIED!)
Look at my coat! (Male: RUINED!)
Where can I hide?!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy metalcore beat)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream)
Try to lick it down, but the static makes it stick!
Other wolves staring! Man, they’re gonna talk quick!
Alpha looks over! Snickers in the fog!
I look like a neon, electrified dog!
It was a surprise attack! She sneaked up behind!
Now I’ve got the ugliest coat you’ll ever find!
Witch laughing loud up on her broomstick seat!
I’m gonna tear her down and make the job complete!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Spells crack! (Male: HIT!)
Sparks fly! (Male: FRIED!)
Look at my coat! (Male: RUINED!)
Where can I hide?!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass)
Zombies in front of me, skeletons behind!
Trying to ignore that I’m losing my mind!
I charge through the horde with a purple glowing mane!
Every monster laughing at my static electricity pain!
I snap three necks just to cover up the shame!
Blaming the witch! Yeah, she’s the one to blame!
Next time a curse comes flying through the night,
I’m dodging the spell so my fur stays tight!

[Bridge]
(crushing deathcore breakdown, heavy double-bass)
(male deep roar)
LOOK AT HER COAT!
(female brutal scream)
DON'T LOOK AT ME!
(male deep roar)
ELECTRIC SHEEP!
(female screams with immense rage)
I’LL KILL YOU ALL FOR LAUGHING AT ME!
SHATTER THE BROOM! TEAR OUT THE SPARK!
(male and female dual shout)
DIE IN THE DARK!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(heavy downtuned 7-string chugs, screeching acid synths)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Witch drops down! Trying for a second shot!
Not this time! I’m taking everything you’ve got!
I jump through the magic! Ignore the purple glow!
Rip off her hat with an iron-claw blow!
Now who’s laughing? Who’s running the fight?
Even with bad hair, I rule the night!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Outro]
(fading downtuned guitar chugs)
(female whispered growl)
Witch is dead... spell is broken...
(male low echo growl)
Fur still frizzy...
(female brutal final scream)
NOBODY SAY A WORD!

songs.title: Bone and Iron V3
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, synthwave metal, aggrotech, 168 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female rap-screamed vocals, soaring melodic female chorus, sparse male sub-bass shouts, distorted supersaw synth, 808 sub-bass drops, explosive electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(screeching supersaw synth, fast double-kick drums)
(male sub-bass chant)
DUST AND MARROW!
(female frantic shriek)
GET OFF MY FEET!

[Verse 1]
(female rap-scream, fast technical delivery)
Chasing witches through the foggy bog!
Skeletons crawling from the log!
Clattering skulls and clicking teeth!
Grabbing my ankles underneath!
Fine bone dust flying in the air!
Getting stuck in my pristine hair!
I came out here to hunt the witch!
Not to scrub off this chalky pitch!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Bones snap! (Male: BREAK!)
Dust flies! (Male: BLIND!)
Grabbing claws! (Male: SHRED!)
Paint the graveyard red!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, light male backing, driving synth-metal beat)
Ripping through the bone-yard in the night!
Fighting under blood-red neon light!
I just wanted a quick and clean pursuit—
Now there’s skeleton dust inside my boot!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Ribcages snapping underfoot!
Covering my coat in ash and soot!
A sharp bone splinter in my pad!
Now I am screaming, furious and mad!
Zombies staggering through the mud!
Drenching my collar in sticky blood!
I can't run fast with a splintered toe!
Every single monster's got to go!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Bones snap! (Male: BREAK!)
Dust flies! (Male: BLIND!)
Grabbing claws! (Male: SHRED!)
Paint the graveyard red!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, light male backing)
Ripping through the bone-yard in the night!
Fighting under blood-red neon light!
I just wanted a quick and clean pursuit—
Now there’s skeleton dust inside my boot!

[Verse 3 - Trap-Metal Shift]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass, glitchy synths)
Drop the beat while the knee caps smash!
Turning these skeletons into ash!
Crushing a skull with a heavy kick!
This whole graveyard is making me sick!
I pull out the thorn, I bite through the spine!
Tearing down the witch on the altar line!
No time for pain, no time for regret!
This is the messiest night I’ll get!

[Interlude - Scent & Splinter Shift]
(glitchy synth arpeggios, atmospheric ambient pads, female breathless clean vocal)
Stopping on a tombstone... shaking out my paw...
Digging out a sharp bone... embedded in the raw...
It stinks like mold... it tastes like chalk...
I just want a quiet midnight walk...

[Bridge - Symphonic Metalcore Escalation]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
You sent your bone army to slow down my stride!
Thought I'd run away or go hide inside!
But a wolf with a splinter is twice as mean!
I'm wiping this entire graveyard clean!

[Crushing Electronicore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal sub-drop, screeching acid synths)
(male sub-bass chant)
SHATTER MARROW!
(female brutal scream)
CLEAN THE PAWS!
(male sub-bass chant)
CRUSH THE SPINE!
(female screams with immense rage)
GET THIS CHALKY DUST OFF MY TAIL RIGHT NOW!
SMASH THE SKULLS!
(male and female dual shout)
GROUND TO DUST!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(hyper-kinetic technical metalcore guitar solo, heavy supersaw arpeggios)

[Verse 4]
(female fast metalcore delivery)
Witch is cornered up against her grave!
Realizing skeletons couldn't save!
I leap through the fog with an iron snap!
Closing down the trap on her witchy cap!
No more curses, no more bone-dust rain!
Just the sweet relief from the petty pain!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Ripping through the bone-yard in the night!
Fighting under blood-red neon light!
I just wanted a quick and clean pursuit—
Now there’s skeleton dust inside my boot!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
Ripping through the bone-yard in the night!
Fighting under blood-red neon light!
I just wanted a quick and clean pursuit—
Now there’s skeleton dust inside my boot!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, quiet wind ambient pads)
(female satisfied growl)
Witch dead... bog cleared...
(male low echo whisper)
Clean your boots...
(female brutal final scream)
WHERE IS THE BUCKET AND SOAP?!

songs.title: Pelt and Polish V3
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, synthwave metal, aggrotech, 168 bpm, 4/4 meter, driving double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female rap-screamed vocals, fast soaring female vocal, sparse male sub-bass shouts, distorted supersaw synth, 808 sub-bass drops, explosive electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(screeching supersaw synth, fast double-kick drum roll)
(male sub-bass shout)
FLESH AND FUR!
(female frantic shriek)
RUN FREE!

[Verse 1]
(female rap-scream, fast technical delivery)
Paws are crashing on the floor!
This is what the woods are for!
Smell of pine and smell of rain!
Lightning running through my brain!
Flavors dancing in the air!
Running wild without a care!
Hunting through the midnight fog!
Leaping over river log!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Smell the earth! (Male: BREATHE!)
Feel the speed! (Male: RUN!)
Human life! (Male: DULL!)
Wolf has won!

[Chorus]
(female fast soaring vocal, driving 168 bpm synth-metal beat)
Love the hunt and love the open sky!
When the wild wolf begins to cry!
Look at this coat caked in mud and burrs!
Nightmare taking proper care of fur!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Thorns and briars in my tail!
Tracking deer along the trail!
Pine sap sticky on my chest!
Grooming is an awful test!
Static making every hair
Stick straight up into a glare!
Fierce predator in the rain!
Messy coat is such a pain!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Smell the earth! (Male: BREATHE!)
Feel the speed! (Male: RUN!)
Human life! (Male: DULL!)
Wolf has won!

[Chorus]
(female fast soaring vocal, light male backing, heavy synth-metal beat)
Love the hunt and love the open sky!
When the wild wolf begins to cry!
Look at this coat caked in mud and burrs!
Nightmare taking proper care of fur!

[Verse 3 - Trap-Metal Shift]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass, screeching synths)
Drop into the human form real fast!
Grab a hairbrush that is built to last!
Running bristles through a silky mane!
No more knots and no more pulling pain!
Smell like lavender and feel so clean!
Prettiest human that you've ever seen!
Mirror glowing in the quiet light!
Sleek and polished for a single night!

[Interlude - Fast Rhythmic Break]
(glitchy synth arpeggios, fast electronic percussion, female fast whispered rant)
Brush is nice... silk is smooth...
Tastes like cardboard... nothing to prove...
No velocity... no sharp claw...
Shifting back into the raw...

[Bridge - Fast Metalcore Escalation]
(fast technical 7-string chugs, driving double-kick)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
I'd rather fight a thousand sticky burrs!
Than live a human life that isn't hers!
Snap the brush and smash the looking glass!
The wild wolf is coming back at last!

[Crushing Electronicore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal 808 sub-drop, screeching supersaw)
(male sub-bass shout)
BRUSH THE FUR!
(female brutal scream)
OR TEAR THE THROAT!
(male sub-bass shout)
DIRTY COAT!
(female screams with immense rage)
I’D RATHER BE A MESSY WOLF THAN A PERFECT HUMAN FREAK!
RIP THE BRUSH!
(male and female dual shout)
THE WOLF IS HERE!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(fast shredding metalcore guitar solo, hyper-kinetic supersaw arpeggios, 168 bpm double-kick)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Back on four legs, shaking off the mud!
Running wild with the pack in my blood!
Bite a branch in two if it gets stuck!
Messy fur is just a stroke of luck!
Howling loud under the yellow moon!
Human hairbrush wait till afternoon!

[Chorus]
(female fast soaring vocal, full anthemic 168 bpm power)
Love the hunt and love the open sky!
When the wild wolf begins to cry!
Look at this coat caked in mud and burrs!
Nightmare taking proper care of fur!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and fast soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
Love the hunt and love the open sky!
When the wild wolf begins to cry!
Look at this coat caked in mud and burrs!
Nightmare taking proper care of fur!

[Outro]
(fading fast heavy electronic guitar chugs)
(female satisfied growl)
Messy, matted... but I am free...
(male low echo whisper)
Wild forever...
(female brutal final scream)
HAND ME THE COMB LATER!
